description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Salvager of Secrets
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Salvager of Secrets
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
